cross_stack.method: Opened all nine side-by-side pairs constructed directly from raw RGB PNGs without resampling using original image detail; includes worst MSE 512x288 phase0 and worst max absolute error 1024x576 phase0. Prior stack is left; new stack is right.
visual_observations: 512x288: all three phases retain the saturated abstract swirls, dominant loops, neon palette and major spatial layout. Small edge, internal stroke and local color differences are visible at native size; these are not byte-equivalent outputs.

768x448: all three phases retain the diagonal pink/cyan branch structure on the left and large dark region on the right. Fine speckle/edge widths and local intensity/color change, especially along bright branches; no major branch disappears in the new stack.

1024x576: all three phases retain the sparse bright ribbon/waveform structures and their phase-specific placement. Fine strand edges, glow and color vary; the high maximum pixel error is local, with no gross layout collapse in the inspected pairs.
The extensive dark areas in both stacks at higher resolutions limit global MSE/PSNR interpretation; scalar closeness does not establish preservation of rich detail absent from the reference.
causal_limits: This is a sequential cross-process comparison on different physical GPU/host runs with the same GPU model name, not a paired isolated Torch version intervention.

Torch, TorchAO and CUDA distributions change together. Process restart, compilation/autotuning/cache state and hardware/clock/host conditions are additional confounds. Do not attribute changed pixels or FPS solely to Torch.

N05 independently found all 18 same-stack FP8 controls changed across attempts (MSE 18.56 to 220.63). That demonstrates restart/attempt variation is plausible; it neither identifies its cause nor provides a transferable acceptance tolerance for these different fixtures.
Only one prompt, one seed, three phases and three resolutions are inspected. No temporal clip, live audio response, flicker, source ordering or full-app quality is established by these still pairs.
